title: Bootstrap guarded automated development control layer
description: Install the task runner, validation profiles, audit trail, Human Gate and ERP-specific path guards without changing business logic.
acceptance_criteria: Runner refuses to execute without Git when require_git is enabled.
Safe validation runs only restore, Release build and ERP.UnitTests.
Database, UI, deployment, SQL, seed, schema and secret-bearing paths require Human Gate approval.
No ERP business source file is changed by this task.
